name: Smart Refill
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: adamjaroui23
description: Automatically refills empty hotbar slots with matching items from your inventory. Works in both Survival and Creative mode!

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: When a hotbar slot runs empty it refills it with the same item from the inventory; in creative (setting creativeInfinite, on by default) it puts back a full stack of the item that was there. The Up arrow key (default code 82) toggles it with '§aSmart Refill Enabled' / '§cSmart Refill Disabled'.
note: Not yet: the survival path (moving a matching stack from the inventory) wasn't tried.
